# CORE

> > CORE is the world's largest aggregator of open access research papers, providing infrastructure, tools, and services to democratize scholarly communication.

CORE, hosted at the Knowledge Media Institute of The Open University, serves as a global hub for open research by indexing millions of papers and offering data providers, researchers, and institutions comprehensive tools for discovery, management, and recommendation. The platform combines persistent identifier resolution (OAI), API access, dataset services, and governance structures to support the open access movement.

## Core Platform & Services

- [CORE Homepage](https://core.ac.uk): The world's largest collection of open access research papers with discovery and search capabilities
- [CORE Services Overview](https://core.ac.uk/services): Complete overview of CORE offerings including API, Dataset, FastSync, Recommender, and Dashboard
- [CORE API](https://core.ac.uk/services): API access for programmatic integration with CORE's research paper database and metadata
- [CORE Dataset](https://core.ac.uk/services): Downloadable dataset of aggregated open access research papers and metadata
- [CORE Dashboard](https://core.ac.uk/services/repository-dashboard): Repository management tool for monitoring outputs, tracking metadata quality, and analytics

## Tools & Integration Services

- [CORE Recommender](https://core.ac.uk/services/recommender): AI-powered research paper recommendation engine available as a plugin for institutional repositories
- [CORE FastSync](https://core.ac.uk/services/fastsync): Data synchronization service using the ResourceSync standard for efficient metadata updates
- [OAI Resolver](https://core.ac.uk/documentation/oai-resolver): Persistent identifier resolution service for OAI identifiers and scholarly object lookup

## For Data Providers & Institutions

- [CORE Membership](https://core.ac.uk/membership): Membership program for data providers with tiered pricing options and enhanced features
- [CORE Consultancy](https://core.ac.uk/services/consultancy): Professional consulting services for research data analysis and scholarly communication strategy
- [CORE Sponsorship](https://core.ac.uk/sponsorship): Sponsorship opportunities to support CORE's mission of open research infrastructure

## Organization & Governance

- [About CORE](https://core.ac.uk/about): CORE organization overview and mission hosted at Knowledge Media Institute, The Open University
- [Governance Structure](https://core.ac.uk/governance): CORE's governance framework and commitment to open scholarly infrastructure principles
- [Advisory Board](https://core.ac.uk/governance/advisory): Advisory Board members providing strategic guidance and expertise
- [Board of Supporters](https://core.ac.uk/governance/supporters): Community-driven governance body shaping CORE's roadmap and strategic direction
- [Join CORE Researcher Network](https://core.ac.uk/governance/research): Collaboration and engagement opportunities for researchers in the CORE community

## Support & Resources

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://core.ac.uk/faq): FAQ covering indexing, repository onboarding, data provider questions, and platform usage
- [CORE Blog](https://blog.core.ac.uk): Tutorials, platform updates, and educational content on CORE features and scholarly communication
